column1: Excellent performance, Commander. The Federated Suns are pleased with what you have accomplished and the skill you've evidenced. Expect our payment in full!
column2: 表现出色，指挥官。联邦太阳国对您的成就与展现出的技艺十分满意。报酬将足额奉上！

column1: Large coffers pay for larger victories—and you have been instrumental in ensuring that our winning streak is intact. Excellent work, mercenary. House Steiner is pleased.
column2: 更大的金库换来更大的胜利——而你在确保我们连胜不败上起到了关键作用。干得漂亮，雇佣兵。施泰纳家族很满意。

column1: Not all battles are so easy to win. Fear not, commander, this is but one minor setback that can be corrected.
column2: 并非所有战斗都那么容易取胜。别担心，指挥官，这只是一次小小的挫折，可以纠正。

column1: Clan Space (Freeborn)
column2: 氏族领地(自由生者)

column1: The Duchy Of Andurien understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a fine effort, even if it failed. Just another lesson for the next battle.
column2: 安杜里恩公国明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已经付出了出色的努力，即便它失败了。这不过是下一场战斗的又一条教训。

column1: The Draconis Combine is pleased with your fervor, Commander. Your skills in battle are precisely the sort that young cadets could learn from.
column2: 天龙联合体对你的热忱表示赞赏，指挥官. 你的作战技艺正是年轻的军校生可以学习的典范.

column1: MechWarriors who hail from the [[DM.Factions[faction_Steiner]  Lyran Commonwealth]] tend to be hardy, well equipped, and well trained, though they have also earned a reputation for not being particularly strategic thinkers on the battlefield.\r\n\r\nWealth is the greatest strength of the merchant princes of the Lyran Commonwealth, ruled by [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseSteiner]  House Steiner]]. Despite a number of humiliating defeats in the first two [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSuccessionWars]  Succession Wars]], the Lyran Commonwealth has bounced back thanks to the combined strength of its economy (the biggest of the five great [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSuccessorState]  Successor States]]) and its control of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere]  Inner Sphere]]'s largest functioning BattleMech factories. What the Lyran Commonwealth may lack in military prowess, it makes up for with raw numbers and industrial scale.
column2: 出身于[[DM.Factions[faction_Steiner]  莱兰联邦]]的机师往往坚韧、装备精良、训练有素，不过他们也落下了在战场上不太讲究战略的名声。\n\n财富是由[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseSteiner]  斯坦纳家族]]统治的莱兰联邦商业诸侯最大的实力所在。尽管在前两次[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSuccessionWars]  继承战争]]中遭受了若干屈辱的失败，莱兰联邦依然凭借其经济体量（五大[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSuccessorState]  继承国]]中最大）与对[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere]  内天体]]最大在运转战斗机甲工厂的控制而重新振作。莱兰联邦或许在军事才能上有所欠缺，但它用纯粹的体量与工业规模弥补了这一点。

column1: Very Legitimate Merchant
column2: 非常合法的商人

column1: For someone with your hardware, I expected better things. You let us down, Commander—and I'm gonna be sure to tell everyone I know not to count on you in the future.
column2: 以你手上的硬件条件，我本以为你能做得更好。你让我们失望了，指挥官——我保证会告诉我认识的每一个人，以后别再指望你。

column1: I'm sorry to learn your mission was a failure, Commander. I hope that occurrences like this will be rare. If they're not, you'll probably be out of 'Mechs before too long.
column2: 得知你的任务失败，我很难过，指挥官。我希望这类事情会很少发生。如果不幸不是，你恐怕很快就会没有机甲可用了。

column1:
The rest of your family died in a freak [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreJumpShip]  JumpShip]] accident, after which you discovered they had left nothing behind but piles of debt.

After selling everything to settle the debt, you set off on your own, with only your family's ancestral [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack]  Blackjack]] left to your name.

+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorPiloting]  Piloting]], +1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGuts]  Guts]]
column2:
你家族其余人死于一场离奇的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreJumpShip]  跃迁舰]]事故，此后你发现他们除了一堆债务什么都没留下。

为偿还债务变卖一切之后，你独自出发，名下只剩家族祖传的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack]  二十一点]]。

+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorPiloting]  驾驶]]，+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGuts]  胆识]]

column1: Officer
column2: 军官

column1: After some training and a lot of networking, you found yourself on the outskirts of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganReach]  Aurigan Reach]], where your most recent contract went horribly wrong. Raju happened to be visiting the planet and picked up your distress call. Upon rescuing you, he offered you a job in the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano]  House Arano]] Royal Guard.\r\n\r\nSo it is that you find yourself reunited with your old mentor, preparing your ancestral [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack]  Blackjack]] for guard duty on the coronation day of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano]  Lady Kamea Arano]]…
column2: 经过一些训练与大量人脉运作，你来到了[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganReach]  奥里根边区]]边缘，而你最近的那份合同在那里惨败。拉朱恰好正在访问该星球，接收到了你的求救信号。救出你之后，他邀请你加入[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano]  阿然诺家族]]皇家卫队。\n\n就这样，你与旧日的导师重逢，为[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano]  卡美娅·阿然诺女士]]加冕当天的守卫任务保养你的祖传[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack]  二十一点]]……

column1: You signed on as a guard for a small trading guild, providing security as the guild's caravan made trading runs between the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere]  Inner Sphere]] and the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery]  Periphery]]. It was a largely uneventful life, but you were able to put your MechWarrior skills to good use in the occasional scuffle with pirates and uncooperative local governments.\r\n\r\n+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorPiloting]  Piloting]]
column2: 你受雇于一家小型贸易行会，为其商队在内层星域与外围地区之间跑贸易时提供安保。生活大体平淡，但你得以在偶尔与海盗和不配合的地方政府的冲突中派上机甲战士的用场。\n\n+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorPiloting]  驾驶]]

column1: Battlesuit Infantry
column2: 战斗装甲步兵

column1: Out here in the Periphery, it's always a life-or-death struggle for mercenaries. That's why I appreciate your efforts to complete the mission, even if you couldn't manage it.
column2: 在外围地区，对雇佣兵来说永远是生死攸关的搏杀。所以即便你没能完成任务，我依然感谢你为此付出的努力。

column1: You were a low-level champion, down on your luck and one bad fight away from the gutter, until Raju heard about you. He trekked all the way to [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSolaris7]  Solaris]] to offer you passage back to the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganReach]  Aurigan Reach]], and a job in the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano]  House Arano]] Royal Guard.\r\n\r\nSo it is that you find yourself reunited with your old mentor, preparing your ancestral [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack]  Blackjack]] for guard duty on the coronation day of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano]  Lady Kamea Arano]]…
column2: 你曾是个低级别冠军，时运不济，再输一场就要沦落街头，直到拉朱听说了你。他一路跋涉到[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSolaris7]  索拉里斯]]，给你提供了一个回到[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganReach]  奥里根边境]]的机会，以及一份在[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano]  阿拉诺家族]]皇家卫队的工作。\n\n于是就这样，你发现自己与昔日的导师重聚，正在为[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano]  卡美娅·阿拉诺女士]]加冕日的守卫任务准备你那台祖传的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack]  黑杰克]]……

column1: House Liao has always believed in one thing, Commander: victory at any cost. It seems you also understand this vital lesson. We are pleased you've performed so well.
column2: 指挥官，廖家始终信奉一件事：不惜一切代价取胜。看来你也深谙这一要义。我们对你的出色表现很满意。

column1: The Duchy of Tamarind-Abbey understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a fine effort, even if it failed. Just another lesson for the next battle.
column2: 塔马林德-阿比公国明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已经付出了出色的努力，即便它失败了。这不过是下一场战斗的又一条教训。

column1: MechWarriors who hail from the [[DM.Factions[faction_MagistracyOfCanopus]  Magistracy of Canopus]] can run the gamut of skill and fighting styles, but they often favor clever and unorthodox tactics on the field.\r\n\r\nWhile smaller than the great [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSuccessorState]  Successor States]] of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere]  Inner Sphere]], the Magistracy of Canopus is one of the major powers of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery]  Rimward Periphery]]. The Magistracy is a matriarchal society led by a Magestrix. This is an elected position open to any woman but largely controlled by [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseCentrella]  House Centrella]] due to the family's popularity. The Magistracy supports an open society that ensures the personal liberty of all citizens and their right to live their lives as they see fit.
column2: 出身于[[DM.Factions[faction_MagistracyOfCanopus]  卡诺帕治安官辖区]]的机师在技能与战斗风格上跨度极大，但他们往往偏爱战场上巧妙而非正统的战术。\n\n虽然比[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere]  内天体]]的各大[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSuccessorState]  继承国]]更小，卡诺帕治安官辖区是[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery]  外缘星区]]的主要势力之一。辖区是一个由女执政官领导的母系社会。这是一个任何女性都可参选的选举职位，但由于家族的声望，实际上大多由[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseCentrella]  森特雷拉家族]]掌控。辖区支持一个开放社会，保障所有公民的个人自由及其按自己意愿生活的权利。

column1: We are deeply disappointed in your performance, Commander. Your efforts on the battlefield were those of a raw cadet, not the leader of a mercenary company.
column2: 我们对你的表现深感失望，指挥官。你在战场上的作为像个新兵，而不是一名佣兵团的领袖。

column1: History
column2: 历史

column1: The Draconis Combine (Kurita)
column2: 天龙联合体（栗田）

column1: While escorting a supply caravan to a small outpost on the outskirts of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganReach]  Aurigan Reach]], you were set upon by pirates and left for dead. Raju happened to be visiting the capital city and picked up your distress call. Upon rescuing you, he offered you a job in the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano]  House Arano]] Royal Guard.\r\n\r\nSo it is that you find yourself reunited with your old mentor, preparing your ancestral [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack]  Blackjack]] for guard duty on the coronation day of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano]  Lady Kamea Arano]]…
column2: 在为前往[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganReach]  奥里根边区]]边缘一处小型前哨的车队护航时，你遭到海盗袭击并被弃之等死。拉朱恰好正在访问首府城市，接收到了你的求救信号。救出你之后，他邀请你加入[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano]  阿然诺家族]]皇家卫队。\n\n就这样，你与旧日的导师重逢，为[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano]  卡美娅·阿然诺女士]]加冕当天的守卫任务保养你的祖传[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack]  二十一点]]……

column1: A Clan Laboratory (Trueborn)
column2: 氏族实验室(真生者)

column1: You win some, you lose some. Sometimes it's in between. I'm disappointed you couldn't complete the contract, but at least you gave it your best shot.
column2: 有输有赢。有时介于两者之间。我很失望你没能完成合同，但至少你尽力了。

column1: Despite your failure, I'll make sure that high command understands you fought as hard as you were able. There's always next time, Commander.
column2: 尽管你失败了，我会确保最高指挥部明白你已尽全力作战。总还有下次，指挥官。

column1:
Once the promising young scion of your family, you committed an unforgivable transgression and were sentenced to life in exile.

You stole away with the family's ancestral [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack]  Blackjack]] and set off to find a new life to call your own.

+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGunnery]  Gunnery]], +1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorTactics]  Tactics]]
column2:
你曾是你家族中大有前途的年轻继承人，却犯下了不可饶恕的过错，被判终身流放。

你带着家族祖传的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack]  黑杰克]]偷偷离开，出发去寻找属于自己的新生活。

+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGunnery]  射击]]，+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorTactics]  战术]]

column1: The Oriente Protectorate understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a fine effort, even if it failed. Just another lesson for the next battle.
column2: 奥连特保护国明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已经付出了出色的努力，即便它失败了。这不过是下一场战斗的又一条教训。

column1: The Federated Suns (Davion)
column2: 恒星联邦（戴维恩）

column1:
Your family was betrayed and its seat of power destroyed. You defeated the betrayers, but you were the sole surviving member of your house.

With nothing but your family's ancestral [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack]  Blackjack]] left to call your own, you set off to make a new life for yourself.

+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGunnery]  Gunnery]], +1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGuts]  Guts]]
column2:
你的家族遭到背叛、权力根基被毁。你击败了背叛者，但你是家族中唯一的幸存者。

名下只剩家族祖传的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack]  二十一点]]，你出发去为自己开辟新生活。

+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGunnery]  炮术]]，+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGuts]  胆识]]

column1: Top-tier work, Commander—The Commonality is very happy with your performance. Keep it up, and I'll make sure a lot more work comes your way.
column2: 一流的活儿，指挥官——共同体对你的表现非常满意。继续保持，我保证会有更多工作找上你。

column1:
As the heir to a noble family, you grew up wanting for nothing. And as it turns out… you couldn't stand a life of pampered nobility.

Finally, one night you stole away with the family's ancestral [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack]  Blackjack]] and set off to find a new life to call your own.

+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorPiloting]  Piloting]], +1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorTactics]  Tactics]]
column2:
作为贵族家族的继承人，你从小要什么有什么。而结果证明……你受不了那种被娇养的高贵生活。

最终，某个夜里你带着家族祖传的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack]  黑杰克]]偷偷离开，出发去寻找属于自己的新生活。

+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorPiloting]  驾驶]]，+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorTactics]  战术]]

column1: Top-tier work, Commander—House Cameron-Jones is very happy with your performance. Keep it up, and I'll make sure a lot more work comes your way.
column2: 一流的活儿，指挥官——卡梅伦-琼斯家族对你的表现非常满意。继续保持，我保证会有更多工作找上你。

column1: The Free Worlds League (Marik)
column2: 自由世界联盟（马里克）

column1: Excellent work, Commander. I was right to put my faith in you. You're a critical part of the Restoration effort.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官。我把信任托付给你是对的。你是复国事业的关键一环。

column1: Your performance was exemplary, Commander. I'll ensure that the Magistracy high command hears about your skills.
column2: 你的表现堪称典范，指挥官。我会确保法域最高指挥部知道你的本事。

column1: The Free Worlds League understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a fine effort, even if it failed. Just another lesson for the next battle.
column2: 自由世界联盟明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已经付出了可贵的努力，即便最终失败。这不过是下一场战斗的又一课。

column1: MechWarriors who hail from the [[DM.Factions[faction_Kurita]  Combine]] tend to be fierce, disciplined, and relentless fighters, no matter the odds they might face on the battlefield.\r\n\r\nAlthough the Draconis Combine is as ethnically diverse as any of the vast interstellar empires, it is also one of the most culturally homogenous. Over centuries of rule, the founding [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseKurita]  House Kurita]] has succeeded in uniting the people of the Combine into a single culture, one heavily molded around medieval Japanese society. While some, most notably the descendants of the conquered [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRaselhague]  Principality of Rasalhague]], continue to chafe at the uniformity of Draconis society, overall this has created a more cohesive populace and military than seen in the other Great Houses of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere]  Inner Sphere]].
column2: 出身于[[DM.Factions[faction_Kurita]  联合体]]的机师往往是凶猛、自律、不屈不挠的战士，无论战场上面对何种劣势。\n\n尽管龙尼斯联合体与任何庞大的星际帝国一样族群多元，它也是最文化统一的政权之一。在数百年的统治中，开国的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseKurita]  栗田家族]]成功将联合体的人民融合为单一文化，一种深受中世纪日本社会塑造的文化。虽然有些人——尤其显著的是被征服的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRaselhague]  拉萨尔哈格公国]]后裔——仍对龙尼斯社会的单一性感到不满，但总体而言，这造就了比[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere]  内天体]]其他大贵族家族更具凝聚力的民众与军队。

column1: Well done, Commander. We obviously placed our faith in the right mercenary company. We'll let you know if we have any other work for you.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。我们显然把信任交给了正确的佣兵团。如果还有活我们通知你。

column1: The Deep Periphery
column2: 深空外围

column1: The Regulan Fiefs understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a fine effort, even if it failed. Just another lesson for the next battle.
column2: 雷古兰封地明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已经付出了出色的努力，即便它失败了。这不过是下一场战斗的又一条教训。

column1: Space
column2: 太空

column1: Mercenary
column2: 雇佣兵

column1: Well, let it never be said House Davion does not believe in charity. Obviously, your skills could not be equivalent to our own regular armies—so we do not blame you for your inability to complete the contract.
column2: 嗯，可别让人说戴维恩家族不信慈善。显然，你的本领无法与我们正规军相提并论——所以我们不怪你没能完成合同。

column1: The Taurian Concordat
column2: 金牛协约国

column1: While running a routine patrol for a local government on the outskirts of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganReach]  Aurigan Reach]], you were set upon by pirates and left for dead. Raju happened to be visiting the capital city and picked up your distress call. Upon rescuing you, he offered you a job in the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano]  House Arano]] Royal Guard.\r\n\r\nSo it is that you find yourself reunited with your old mentor, preparing your ancestral [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack]  Blackjack]] for guard duty on the coronation day of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano]  Lady Kamea Arano]]…
column2: 在为[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganReach]  奥里根边区]]边缘的某地政府执行例行巡逻时，你遭到海盗袭击并被弃之等死。拉朱恰好正在访问首府城市，接收到了你的求救信号。救出你之后，他邀请你加入[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano]  阿然诺家族]]皇家卫队。\n\n就这样，你与旧日的导师重逢，为[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano]  卡美娅·阿然诺女士]]加冕当天的守卫任务保养你的祖传[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack]  二十一点]]……

column1: You were an attempt by the science caste to convert a mechwarrior to a protomech pilot.
column2: 你是科学家种姓把机甲战士改造成原机甲飞行员的一次尝试。

column1: The Lyran Commonwealth didn't get where it is by accepting victory or defeat as inevitable, but by continuing to fight after a loss. I hope you'll do the same, Commander. While you were defeated, you acquitted yourself well.
column2: 莱兰联邦不是靠把胜利或失败视为必然才有今天的地位，而是靠在失败之后继续战斗。我希望你也能如此，指挥官。你虽然战败，但表现可圈可点。

column1: Loss on the battlefield is not always failure. Losses teach us to improve and better ourselves. You fought well, Commander, even if you did not prevail. Learn from this lesson and do better next time.
column2: 在战场上失利并不完全意味着失败. 失利教会我们改善和提升自己. 你打得不错，指挥官，即使你没有取得胜利. 引以为戒，在下次任务中做得更好.

column1: Good job, Commander. The Calderon Protectorate thanks you for your service. It's always refreshing to deal with a true professional when one hires mercenaries.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。卡尔德隆保护国感谢你的效力。雇雇佣兵时能碰上一个真正的专业人士，总是令人神清气爽。

column1: Survival
column2: 生存

column1: Far be it for a simple organization like Comstar to reprimand you in matters of warfare, Commander, but… Your performance on that operation was positively abysmal. We roundly condemn your inadequacies.
column2: 像康星这样简单的组织本不该在战争事务上责备你，指挥官，但是……你在那次行动中的表现简直糟糕透顶。我们严厉谴责你的无能。

column1: The Capellan Confederation (Liao)
column2: 卡佩拉联邦（廖氏）

column1: Solaris Gladiator
column2: 索拉里斯角斗士

column1: The Lyran Commonwealth (Steiner)
column2: 天琴共同体（施泰纳）

column1: It may have been years since you last spoke to your great-uncle but you must have left an impression or you were simply the only one left in the family. While his passing didn't leave you with his money; it did leave you with some information on his business contacts, his prized 'Mech freshly pulled out of mothballs, and a request to make a name for yourself.
column2: 你也许已经很多年没跟叔祖父说过话，但你一定给他留下了印象，或者你只是家族里剩下的唯一一个。他的去世没有留给你他的钱，却留给你一些关于他生意伙伴的信息、他那台刚从封存中取出的珍贵机甲，以及一个出人头地的请求。

column1: Team Banzai Test Pilot
column2: Banzai测试机师

column1: Understand that we hired you with an expectation of - if not success - at least decent effort. You've shown neither, and I'm going to ensure my superiors hear about it, Commander.
column2: 希望你能明白，我们雇你时，期待的是——就算不能成功——至少也得有像样的努力。你两者都没做到，而我会确保我的上级知道这件事，指挥官。

column1: While your retreat would be grounds for censure in one of our soldiers, we understand that a mercenary life is more… complicated. We hope it will not become a habit, however.
column2: 虽然你的撤退若发生在我们自己的士兵身上会招致谴责，但我们理解雇佣兵的生活更为……复杂。不过我们希望这不会成为习惯。

column1: Understand that we hired you with an expectation of, if not success, at least decent effort. You've shown neither, and I'm going to ensure my superiors hear about it, Commander.
column2: 你要明白，我们雇用你时，即便不指望你成功，至少也期待你能拿出像样的努力。可这两样你都没做到，我会确保我的上级知道这件事，指挥官。

column1: Gambling
column2: 赌博

column1: Flight School Instructor
column2: 飞行学校教官

column1: Freelancer
column2: 自由职业者

column1: Come now, mercenary—did you even try to complete the contract, or did you believe we'd pay you for your own inadequacies? Such a dismal performance cannot be rewarded, only reprimanded.
column2: 得了吧，雇佣兵——你到底有没有尽力去履行合同，还是以为我们会为你自己的无能付钱？如此糟糕的表现得不到奖赏，只能受到训斥。

column1: Good job, Commander. The Taurian Concordat thanks you for your service. It's always refreshing to deal with a true professional when one hires mercenaries.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官。金牛座协约感谢你的效力。雇雇佣兵时能碰上真正的专业人士，总是让人耳目一新。

column1: Eager to get away from it all, you joined up with a minor [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere]  Inner Sphere]] mercenary unit. Integrating into the tight-knit crew took time, but you eventually proved your worth and became part of the family.\r\n\r\n+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorTactics]  Tactics]]
column2: 急于抛开一切，你加入了一支内天体的次要雇佣兵部队。融入这个关系紧密的团队花了些时间，但你最终证明了自己的价值，成为了家中的一员。\n\n+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorTactics]  战术]]

column1: MechWarriors who hail from the [[DM.Factions[faction_Davion]  Federated Suns]] tend to possess more finely honed skills and better equipment than their counterparts from other regions of space. They often see themselves as righteous warriors and champions of liberty - sometimes to a fault.\r\n\r\nThough nearly extinguished by the [[DM.Factions[faction_Kurita]  Draconis Combine]] in the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreFirstSuccessionWar]  First Succession War]], the Federated Suns - a constitutional monarchy ruled by the renowned [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseDavion]  House Davion]] - has become arguably the most powerful of the five great [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSuccessorState]  Successor States]]. Through skillful military campaigns and subtle diplomacy, House Davion has significantly increased the number of star systems under its control in the last two centuries.
column2: 出身于[[DM.Factions[faction_Davion]  联邦太阳]]的机师往往比太空中其他区域的同行拥有更精湛的技能和更好的装备。他们常把自己视为正义的战士与自由的捍卫者——有时过于如此。\n\n尽管在[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreFirstSuccessionWar]  第一次继承战争]]中几乎被[[DM.Factions[faction_Kurita]  龙尼斯联合体]]灭国，这个由著名的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseDavion]  达维昂家族]]统治的君主立宪国如今可以说是五大[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSuccessorState]  继承国]]中最强大的。凭借高超的军事行动与巧妙的外交，达维昂家族在过去两个世纪里大幅增加了其控制的星系数量。

column1: Inheritor
column2: 继承者

column1: ComStar congratulates you on your successful mission, mercenary. We are pleased you've been able to assist us so thoroughly.
column2: 康星祝贺你任务成功，佣兵。我们很高兴你能如此彻底地协助我们。

column1: Despite your failure, I'll ensure that high command understands that you fought as hard as you were able. There's always next time, Commander.
column2: 尽管你失败了，我会确保最高指挥部明白你已经竭尽全力作战。总还有下一次，指挥官。

column1: That went well. Real well. Seems like we did the right thing in calling you in, mercenary. Glad to see we both came out ahead today.
column2: 进展顺利. 非常顺利. 看来请你出手是正确的决定，雇佣兵. 很高兴看到我们今天都获益匪浅.

column1: It seems apparent that while you failed to achieve our goals, you engaged the enemy for as long as you were able. Better luck next time, Commander. May the Spirit of Blake be with you.
column2: 这看起来似乎很显然，虽然你没有达成我们的目标，但已经尽你所能来和敌人交战了. 希望你下次能走运一些，指挥官. 希望布雷克的精神与你同在.

column1: After years of roaming the Frontier, your outfit's luck eventually ran out, landing you in an [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganCoalition]  Aurigan Coalition]] prison. Hearing of your bad turn of fortune, Raju dragged you out of jail, giving you a second chance under his mentorship. After heavy rehabilitation, you proved your worth and were inducted into the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano]  House Arano]] Royal Guard.\r\n\r\nSo it is that you find yourself reunited with your old mentor, preparing your ancestral [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack]  Blackjack]] for guard duty on the coronation day of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano]  Lady Kamea Arano]]…
column2: 在边疆漂泊多年之后，你的部队终于耗尽了运气，你被关进了[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganCoalition]  Aurigan Coalition]]的监狱。得知你遭遇不幸，Raju将你从狱中拉了出来，在他的指导下给了你第二次机会。经过艰苦的康复训练，你证明了自己的价值，被吸纳入[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano]  House Arano]]皇家卫队。\r\n\r\n就这样，你与昔日的导师重逢，为自己的祖传[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack]  Blackjack]]做好护卫准备，迎接[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano]  Lady Kamea Arano]]的加冕典礼……

column1: MechWarriors who hail from the [[DM.Factions[faction_TaurianConcordat]  Taurian Concordat]] tend to be stubborn and aggressive. They can be quick to anger, but they are nonetheless skilled and perceptive combatants. \r\n\r\nFounded as a constitutional monarchy under the leadership of [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseCalderon]  House Calderon]], the Taurian Concordat is the strongest military power of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery]  Rimward Periphery]]. It is also one of the oldest surviving realms of human civilization, having been formed long before the creation of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreStarLeague]  Star League]]. Taurian citizens enjoy extensive freedoms guaranteed by the Concordat Charter, and take pride in defending those freedoms through compulsory service. The Taurian Concordat has long had an antagonistic relationship with the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere]  Inner Sphere]], particularly with the [[DM.Factions[faction_Davion]  Federated Suns]].
column2: 出身于[[DM.Factions[faction_TaurianConcordat]  陶里安协约国]]的机师往往固执而好斗。他们容易发怒，但依然是技艺娴熟、洞察敏锐的战斗者。\n\n陶里安协约国建立时是[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseCalderon]  卡尔德隆家族]]领导下的君主立宪国，也是[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery]  外缘星区]]最强的军事力量。它同时是人类文明中最古老的幸存政权之一，其成立远早于[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreStarLeague]  星盟]]的建立。陶里安公民享有《协约国宪章》保障的广泛自由，并以通过义务服役来捍卫这些自由为荣。陶里安协约国与[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere]  内天体]]长期敌对，尤其是与[[DM.Factions[faction_Davion]  联邦太阳]]。

column1: You disappoint me, commander. For the sake of your company, I would hope that this does not become a habit.
column2: 你让我失望了，指挥官。为了你的公司着想，我希望这不会成为习惯。

column1: MechWarriors who hail from the [[DM.Factions[faction_Marik]  Free Worlds League]] tend to be passionate, enduring fighters who value justice and equality above all else.\r\n\r\nThe oldest, and theoretically most democratic, of the great [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSuccessorState]  Successor States]] of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere]  Inner Sphere]], the Free Worlds League is actually a broad coalition of many minor noble houses. For most of the League's history, it has been ruled under martial law by a Captain-General, who by tradition is from [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseMarik]  House Marik]]. The cultural diversity and relative independence of its component regions are at once the greatest strength of the Free Worlds League, and its greatest weaknesses.
column2: 来自[[DM.Factions[faction_Marik]  自由世界联盟]]的机甲战士往往是充满激情、坚韧不拔的战士，把正义与平等置于一切之上。\n\n作为[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere]  内层星域]]各[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSuccessorState]  继承国]]中最古老、理论上最民主的一个，自由世界联盟实际上是众多小贵族家族的广泛联盟。在联盟历史的大部分时间里，它由一位总上将依军事管制统治，而按传统这位总上将出自[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseMarik]  马里克家族]]。各组成区域的文化多样性与相对独立性，既是自由世界联盟最大的优势，也是其最大的弱点。

column1: The Periphery
column2: 外围

column1: House Steiner has no place for cowards or failures, Commander. Ensure your future efforts are more robust, or the Lyran Commonwealth will be no friend to you.
column2: 指挥官，施泰纳家族没有胆小鬼或失败者的位置. 确保你未来的成绩更加强劲，不然天琴共同体不会同你交好.

column1: Your performance was an embarrassment, Commander. The Draconis Combine expects more of their mercenaries. Keep this up, and we may not offer you any contracts at all!
column2: 指挥官，你的表现令人难堪. 天龙联合体对他们的佣兵期待更大. 如果你继续保持这种状态，那我们可能根本不会给你任何合约!

column1: Unsure of your prospects, you traveled to [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreCoromodir]  Coromodir]], the capital of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganCoalition]  Aurigan Coalition]], and enlisted in the Coalition military. You quickly rose through the ranks, distinguishing yourself as a reliable MechWarrior. Life as a soldier wasn't glamorous, but it suited you just fine.\r\n\r\n+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGunnery]  Gunnery]]
column2: 前途未卜的你前往 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreCoromodir]  Coromodir]]——[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganCoalition]  Aurigan Coalition]] 的首都，并加入了联盟军队。你很快在军阶中步步高升，以可靠的机甲战士之名崭露头角。士兵的生活并不光鲜，却正合你意。\r\n\r\n+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGunnery]  Gunnery]]

column1: Top-tier work, Commander—House Marik is very happy with your performance. Keep it up, and I'll make sure a lot more work comes your way.
column2: 顶级表现，指挥官——马里克家族对你的成绩非常满意。继续保持，我会确保更多活找上你。

column1: The Free Rasalhague Republic
column2: 自由蛇夫座共和国

column1: You roamed the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery]  Rimward Periphery]] as a freelancer, signing on for whatever odd contracts you could find as a MechWarrior for hire. It was a solitary life - but as you became more comfortable with the itinerant lifestyle, you found you were able to make a decent living helping the people of the frontier.\r\n\r\n+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorTactics]  Tactics]]
column2: 你以自由身游荡于[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery]  Rimward Periphery]]，作为一名受雇的机甲战士，接下一切能找到的零散合同。那是种孤独的生活——但随着你逐渐适应了漂泊的日子，你发现自己能靠着帮助边疆的人们过上不错的生活。\r\n\r\n+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorTactics]  Tactics]]

column1: Technology
column2: 科技

column1: MechWarriors that hail from the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDeepPeriphery]  Deep Periphery]] are rare, but even rarer is the MechWarrior who will admit to such an origin. \r\n\r\nBeyond the outermost edges of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery]  Periphery]] lie depths of space that remain uncharted and unknown to most of human civilization. Little is known about these regions, but they are far from uninhabited. The Deep Periphery is littered with abandoned colonies and small outposts, isolated from the rest of humanity. After the fall of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreStarLeague]  Star League]], General [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKerensky]  Aleksandr Kerensky]] led the remnants of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSLDF]  Star League Defense Force]] into the Deep Periphery, disappearing from the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere]  Inner Sphere]] and from recorded history.
column2: 来自[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDeepPeriphery]  深远外缘]]的机师很罕见，但更罕见的是愿意承认这种出身的机师。\n\n在[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery]  外缘]]最外侧的边缘之外，是大部人类文明都未曾测绘、未知的深空。人们对这些区域知之甚少，但它们远非无人居住。深远外缘散落着与人类其余部分隔绝的废弃殖民地与小前哨。在[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreStarLeague]  星盟]]覆灭之后，[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKerensky]  亚历山大·克伦斯基]]将军率领[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSLDF]  星盟防卫部队]]的残部进入深远外缘，从此从[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere]  内天体]]和成文史中消失。

column1: You took your skills as a MechWarrior to the famed arena planet of [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSolaris7]  Solaris VII]]. There, you eked out a living as a gladiator, fighting for the crowd in minor arenas, getting by from paycheck to paycheck.\r\n\r\n+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGunnery]  Gunnery]]
column2: 你把自己作为机甲战士的技艺带到了著名的竞技场星球[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSolaris7]  索拉里斯VII]]。在那里你以角斗士为生，在小竞技场为观众搏杀，靠一份份薪水勉强度日。\n\n+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGunnery]  炮术]]

column1: Far be it from a simple organization like ComStar to reprimand you in matters of warfare, Commander, butâ€¦ your performance on that operation was positively abysmal. We roundly condemn your inadequacies.
column2: 像通讯之星这样简单的组织本不该在作战事务上斥责你，指挥官，但……你在那次行动中的表现实在糟糕透顶。我们对你的无能予以严正谴责。

column1: The Magistracy of Canopus
column2: 卡诺普斯法域

column1: Top-tier work, Commander—House Humphreys is very happy with your performance. Keep it up, and I'll make sure a lot more work comes your way.
column2: 一流的活儿，指挥官——汉弗莱斯家族对你的表现非常满意。继续保持，我保证会有更多工作找上你。

column1:
As you grew older, you watched your family's fortune, income, and influence slowly dwindle away - until there was nothing left. Your parents, driven to despair, took their own lives.

With nothing but your family's ancestral [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack]  Blackjack]] left to call your own, you set off to make a new life for yourself.

+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorTactics]  Tactics]], +1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGuts]  Guts]]
column2:
随着你长大，你看着家族的财富、收入与影响力慢慢枯竭——直到一无所有。你的父母被绝望逼到绝境，自尽身亡。

只剩家族祖传的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack]  黑杰克]]算作你的东西，你出发为自己开创一种新生活。

+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorTactics]  战术]]，+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGuts]  胆识]]

column1: Your performance was exemplary, Commander. I'll be certain to ensure the upper echelons of Magistracy high command hear about your skills.
column2: 你的表现堪称典范，指挥官。我一定会确保治安官辖区最高指挥部的上层听到你的本领。

column1: I've hired raw cadets that have performed better than your company, Commander. In the future, you'd best operate at a higher level, or we might not be willing to offer you contracts aside from garrison duty.
column2: 指挥官，我雇来的生瓜蛋子新兵表现都比你的队伍强。以后你最好拿出更高的水准，否则除了驻防任务，我们可能就不愿再给你合同了。

column1: Tired of living under the authority of others, you fell in with a local pirate gang in the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery]  Rimward Periphery]]. It was an unruly crew, but an effective one - roaming the Periphery afforded your outfit with a steady supply of poorly defended merchant caravans and supply depots to prey upon. While raids did occasionally devolve into combat, you quickly learned that successful piracy is mostly about being in the right place, at the right time, with the right threats and a good show of force.\r\n\r\n+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGuts]  Guts]]
column2: 厌倦了活在他人权威之下的日子，你混进了[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery]  Rimward Periphery]]当地的一伙海盗帮派。这帮人桀骜难驯，却也相当能干——在外围地区游荡，让你这支队伍有了稳定的猎物来源：防御薄弱的商队和补给站。突袭偶尔会演变成正面交战，但你很快就明白，成功的海盗行当多半靠的是在对的时间出现在对的地点、摆出对的威胁，再加上一场像样的武力展示。\r\n\r\n+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGuts]  Guts]]

column1: It wasn't a total wash, but it sure wasn't a roaring success, either. I understand that not every mission is going to be a gold-star victory, but I hope this isn't an indication of future performance.
column2: 这次任务算不上彻底失败，但也绝对不是大获成功。我明白不是每次任务都能拿满星凯旋，但我希望这并不预示着今后的表现。

column1: ProtoMech Pilot Test Subject
column2: 原型机甲机师测试对象

column1: Enlisted MechWarrior
column2: 入伍机甲战士

column1: For somebody who came so highly recommended, you let us down pretty hard. Thanks for nothing, I guess.
column2: 对于一个被强烈推荐的人来说，你却让我们很失望. 算我自讨没趣，我猜.

column1: The Rim Commonality understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a fine effort, even if it failed. Just another lesson for the next battle.
column2: 边缘共同体明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已经付出了出色的努力，即便它失败了。这不过是下一场战斗的又一条教训。

column1: There is no easy way to characterize MechWarriors hailing from the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery]  Rimward Periphery]] - they can be anything from petty thugs to ruthless tacticians to skilled and honorable warriors.\r\n\r\nThe nations and minor noble houses of the Rimward Periphery have long played a role in shaping humanity - the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreStarLeague]  Star League]]'s downfall began in the Periphery, eventually leading to the current tattered state of these disparate star systems on the edge of known space. The Periphery is still the galaxy's frontier, where the Great Houses of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere]  Inner Sphere]] play deadly politics, petty bandit kingdoms thrive, and pirate bands prey on the minor noble houses trying to survive in this hostile environment.
column2: 来自[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery]  外缘星区]]的机师很难一概而论——他们可以是从小混混到冷酷的战术家再到技艺精湛、光明磊落的战士。\n\n外缘星区的诸国与小贵族家族长期以来都在塑造人类历史中扮演着角色——[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreStarLeague]  星盟]]的覆灭正是始于外缘，最终导致这些散落在已知空间边缘的星系陷入如今破败的境地。外缘至今仍是银河的边疆：[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere]  内天体]]的大贵族家族在此进行致命的博弈，小小的匪帮王国在此繁荣，海盗团伙则劫掠着在这片险恶环境中挣扎求存的小贵族家族。

column1: The Marik-Stewart Commonwealth understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a fine effort, even if it failed. Just another lesson for the next battle.
column2: 马里克-斯图尔特联邦明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已经付出了出色的努力，即便它失败了。这不过是下一场战斗的又一条教训。

column1: On an ill-fated mission, you were caught behind enemy lines and separated from your lance. Raju happened to be on patrol nearby, and he launched a daring rescue. Upon finding out it was you he had rescued, he brought you into the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano]  House Arano]] Royal Guard.\r\n\r\nSo it is that you find yourself reunited with your old mentor, preparing your ancestral [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack]  Blackjack]] for guard duty on the coronation day of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano]  Lady Kamea Arano]]…
column2: 在一次不幸的任务中，你被困在敌后，与小队失去了联系。拉朱恰好正在附近巡逻，他发起了一场大胆的营救。当发现救出的正是你之后，他把你带进了[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano]  阿然诺家族]]皇家卫队。\n\n就这样，你与旧日的导师重逢，为[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano]  卡美娅·阿然诺女士]]加冕当天的守卫任务保养你的祖传[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack]  二十一点]]……

column1: If you cannot accomplish the missions we lay before you, Commander, we will find another mercenary who can! Consider this a warning to perform better—or be replaced.
column2: 指挥官，如果你无法完成我们交给你的任务，我们会另找一位能完成的雇佣兵！把这当作一次警告：要么干得更好，要么被替换。

column1: Good work, my friend. You continue to impress me. House Espinosa - no, all the Aurigan people - are in your debt.
column2: 干得好，我的朋友。你继续让我印象深刻。埃斯皮诺萨家族——不，所有奥里根人民——都欠你的。

column1: Pure chance brought you back to the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganReach]  Aurigan Reach]], as your mercenary crew took an ill-fated contract against an enclave of pirates on the outskirts of Aurigan space. The job went south, and you were the only survivor of your unit. Raju's lance happened to be on patrol nearby. After rescuing you and helping to honor your fallen comrades, he offered you a job in the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano]  House Arano]] Royal Guard.\r\n\r\nSo it is that you find yourself reunited with your old mentor, preparing your ancestral [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack]  Blackjack]] for guard duty on the coronation day of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano]  Lady Kamea Arano]]…
column2: 纯属偶然把你带回了[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganReach]  奥里根边境]]——你的雇佣兵队伍在奥里根空间郊外接了一份对海盗飞地的倒霉合约。活儿砸了，你是全队唯一的幸存者。拉朱的分队恰好就在附近巡逻。在救下你、并帮你悼念阵亡战友之后，他给了你一份在[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano]  阿拉诺家族]]皇家卫队的工作。\n\n于是就这样，你发现自己与昔日的导师重聚，正在为[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano]  卡美娅·阿拉诺女士]]加冕日的守卫任务准备你那台祖传的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack]  黑杰克]]……

column1: Top-tier work, Commander—The Marik-Stewart Commonwealth is very happy with your performance. Keep it up, and I'll make sure a lot more work comes your way.
column2: 一流的活儿，指挥官——马里克-斯图尔特联邦对你的表现非常满意。继续保持，我保证会有更多工作找上你。

column1: Top-tier work, Commander—The Duchy is very happy with your performance. Keep it up, and I'll make sure a lot more work comes your way.
column2: 一流的活儿，指挥官——公国对你的表现非常满意。继续保持，我保证会有更多工作找上你。

column1: MechWarriors who hail from the [[DM.Factions[faction_Liao]  Capellan Confederation]] are dedicated and steadfast combatants, capable of holding the line and often surprising those opponents who would make the mistake of underestimating them.\r\n\r\nThe Capellan Confederation has suffered the most at the hands of the other [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSuccessorState]  Successor States]] over the last two centuries of war, having lost nearly half of the territory it once controlled at the height of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreStarLeague]  Star League]]'s rule. Over time, the leadership of [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseLiao]  House Liao]] has transformed the Capellan Confederation into a socialist police state with a highly regulated economy. Most Capellans take great pride in their citizenship, which must be earned through service to the state.
column2: 出身于[[DM.Factions[faction_Liao]  卡佩兰联邦]]的机师是坚毅而忠诚的战斗者，能守住阵线，常常让那些错误低估他们的对手大吃一惊。\n\n在过去两个世纪的战争中，卡佩兰联邦在其他[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSuccessorState]  继承国]]手中吃的苦头最多，失去了它曾在[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreStarLeague]  星盟]]统治鼎盛期控制过的近一半领土。随着时间推移，[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseLiao]  廖家族]]的领导层把卡佩兰联邦改造成一个经济高度管制的社会主义警察国家。大多数卡佩兰人为自己的公民身份深感自豪，而这必须通过对国家的服务来赢得。

column1: You didn't get the job done like we wanted, but you tried. And I like that kind of guts, even if I'm not entirely happy with the result.
column2: 你没能按我们希望的那样完成，但你尽力了。我欣赏这种胆气，即使我对结果并不完全满意。

column1: Commando Veteran
column2: 突击队老兵
